syllabus_topics: Models and projects related to trains and automobiles
Calculation and models of structures and joints of structural elements
teaching_methods: Supervision by a Technological Campus professor (and a company person if the project is carried out outside the Campus)
Initial training provided by supervisors to successfully approach each phase of the project
Putting into practice the competencies acquired during the Degree in the realization of the project
assessment_rules: The Final Degree Project is evaluated by a digital report and a public defense. The defense takes place only if the supervisor approves the project's quality. After the defense, the tribunal members will deliberate and numerically evaluate the project. The result will be communicated as Pass or Fail. If a student receives a Fail grade in the ordinary examination, they must attend the extraordinary examination, where they can choose to present a new project or revise the original one following the academic supervisor's instructions.
